bitcoin_articles.headline: Core Scientific Reports Q3 2026 Financial Results and Strategic Pivot to Colocation
bitcoin_articles.summary: Core Scientific announced its third-quarter 2026 financial results, reporting revenue of $232.9 million and a net income of $1.18 billion, largely driven by a non-cash warrant gain. The company also confirmed plans to exit its Bitcoin self-mining business by the end of 2026 to focus exclusively on high-density colocation services.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Bitcoin Treasury Corporation Provides October Update on Normal Course Issuer Bid
bitcoin_articles.summary: Bitcoin Treasury Corporation reported the repurchase and retirement of 99,500 common shares during October 2026 as part of its ongoing Normal Course Issuer Bid.

bitcoin_articles.headline: American Bitcoin Corp. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
bitcoin_articles.summary: American Bitcoin Corp. reported Q3 2026 revenue of approximately $63.4 million and net income of $126 million, driven largely by gains on its Bitcoin holdings.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Trump Media Transfers Bitcoin Collateral to Crypto.com
bitcoin_articles.summary: Trump Media & Technology Group transferred approximately 4,259 BTC to the exchange Crypto.com, raising questions regarding the company's liquidity and potential asset liquidation.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Bullish Releases Monthly Metrics for October 2026
bitcoin_articles.summary: Bullish (NYSE: BLSH) has published its monthly performance metrics for October 2026, detailing trading volume, average trading spreads, and volatility data for Bitcoin and Ethereum.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Riot Platforms Announces Q3 Bitcoin Sales and Major AI Data Center Lease Agreement
bitcoin_articles.summary: Riot Platforms reported the sale of 10,599 BTC in Q3 2026 to fund AI infrastructure and secured a 15-year, 910 MW data center lease agreement in Texas.
